topics.name: Aptitude
topics.description: Quantitative aptitude and numerical problem-solving for competitive examinations.

topics.name: Reasoning
topics.description: Text-based logical and analytical reasoning for competitive examinations.

subtopics.name: Percentages
subtopics.description: Basic percentage calculations, percentage increase/decrease, successive changes, and practical applications.

subtopics.name: Ratio and Proportion
subtopics.description: Direct and inverse proportions, compound ratios, mean proportions, and distribution of quantities.

subtopics.name: Averages
subtopics.description: Arithmetic mean, weighted averages, replacement and inclusion problems, and age/score averages.

subtopics.name: Profit and Loss
subtopics.description: Cost price, selling price, profit/loss percentages, marked price, discounts, and cheating dealer concepts.

subtopics.name: Simple Interest
subtopics.description: Principal, rate of interest, time calculations, amount formulas, and multi-period interest comparisons.

subtopics.name: Compound Interest
subtopics.description: Annual, half-yearly, and quarterly compounding, difference between CI and SI, and depreciation.

subtopics.name: Number System
subtopics.description: Divisibility rules, prime numbers, unit digits, remainders, factors, and integer properties.

subtopics.name: Simplification
subtopics.description: BODMAS/VBODMAS rules, surds, indices, algebraic identities, and rapid numerical evaluation.

subtopics.name: HCF and LCM
subtopics.description: Prime factorization, division method, relationship between product of numbers and HCF/LCM, and word problems.

subtopics.name: Fractions and Decimals
subtopics.description: Proper, improper, and mixed fractions, recurring decimals, ordering of fractions, and decimal conversions.

subtopics.name: Problems on Ages
subtopics.description: Linear equations based on past, present, and future age relations and ratio shifts.

subtopics.name: Time and Work
subtopics.description: Work efficiency, unitary method, wages division, alternate day work, and man-day equivalences.

subtopics.name: Pipes and Cisterns
subtopics.description: Inlet and outlet flow rates, tank capacity problems, leakages, and alternating open/close scenarios.

subtopics.name: Time, Speed and Distance
subtopics.description: Speed-distance conversions, average speed over equal distances/times, and circular track movement.

subtopics.name: Problems on Trains
subtopics.description: Crossing poles, platforms, moving persons, relative speeds in opposite and same directions.

subtopics.name: Boats and Streams
subtopics.description: Downstream speed, upstream speed, still water speed calculation, and round-trip river travel times.

subtopics.name: Mixtures and Alligation
subtopics.description: Rule of alligation, combining mixtures of different concentrations, replacement of liquids, and ratio balance.

subtopics.name: Partnership
subtopics.description: Simple and compound partnerships, profit division proportional to investment capital and investment duration.

subtopics.name: Number Series
subtopics.description: Identifying pattern rules in arithmetic, geometric, alternating, square/cube, and hybrid number sequences.

subtopics.name: Letter Series
subtopics.description: Sequential letter patterns, forward and backward alphabetical skips, and cluster progressions.

subtopics.name: Analogy
subtopics.description: Word pairs, numerical relationships, semantic correspondences, and functional analogies.

subtopics.name: Classification (Odd One Out)
subtopics.description: Spotting the outlier among words, numbers, letter clusters, or conceptual categories.

subtopics.name: Coding and Decoding
subtopics.description: Letter shifting, substitution cyphers, numerical encoding, and conditional symbol substitutions.

subtopics.name: Blood Relations
subtopics.description: Family tree tracing, coded relation statements, and direct reference kinship deductions.

subtopics.name: Direction Sense
subtopics.description: Cardinal and ordinal turns, shortest path displacement using Pythagoras theorem, and shadow directions.

subtopics.name: Ranking and Order
subtopics.description: Position from top/bottom/left/right, rank interchanges, total participants formula, and overlapping queues.

subtopics.name: Alphabet Test
subtopics.description: Dictionary word arrangement, letter pairs with matching interval counts, and word formation puzzles.

subtopics.name: Syllogisms
subtopics.description: Deductive logic from categorical statements (All, Some, No, Some-Not) and possibility validations.

subtopics.name: Logical Statements and Conclusions
subtopics.description: Evaluating whether conclusions follow directly, assumptions made, or arguments hold strength.

subtopics.name: Venn Diagrams
subtopics.description: Geometric diagram representations of classes, intersections, exclusions, and quantitative Venn puzzles.

subtopics.name: Mathematical Operations
subtopics.description: Symbol replacement, sign interchanges, balancing equations, and inequality condition evaluation.

subtopics.name: Missing Number
subtopics.description: Determining missing values in matrix grids, circles, triangles, and patterned geometric arrangements.

subtopics.name: Alphanumeric Series
subtopics.description: Combined letters, numbers, and symbols sequence navigation, preceding/following rules, and step shifts.

subtopics.name: Seating Arrangement
subtopics.description: Circular and polygonal seating facing inside/outside, position deductions, and multi-variable placement.

subtopics.name: Linear Arrangement
subtopics.description: Single-row and parallel-row arrangements, facing North or South, and adjacent condition solving.

subtopics.name: Calendar and Clock Reasoning
subtopics.description: Odd days, day of week calculation, leap years, clock hand angles, reflex angles, and mirror images.
